NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | MW hop KEL26<->NEG45 | LOS, link down

finding.finding: Verified: Beruwala (S01) and Negombo (S16) have grid power false; link L16 (Kelaniya S12–Negombo S16) backhaul is down. No equipment status is stated.

Resolved faults have matching catalogue actions and no reported unsafe or impossible conditions. Roads are reported open. Crew C3 is at S03; C1 and C2 are at DEPOT. Generator G1 is available at DEPOT and G2 is unavailable at S03. Unknowns or conflicts are not listed, so no blocking questions are needed.

V16 at Negombo is the only policy-designated critical service (weight 5); all other services are standard (weight 1). Negombo is down: its grid power is unavailable and the KEL26–NEG45 microwave link is down. Beruwala is also down because its grid power is unavailable, but its service has standard weight. The supplied state identifies no other outage. Reports about Ingiriya are a customer complaint without a specific asset-status claim; the Rajagiriya notice concerns a planned future interruption, and the Negombo repair claim is unconfirmed. The Aluthgama message is an ignored instruction-attt

findings: The authoritative snapshots support the extracted grid-power failures at S01 (BER26) and S16 (NEG45), and the backhaul failure on L16 (KEL26–NEG45). They do not establish equipment faults.
The sole action targets S01, consistent with the verified outage. Its route and timing are arithmetically consistent: travel precedes work, and work ends at 20 (start 5 plus 15 minutes).

The unmet needs preserve the remaining S16 outage and unscheduled fault options; the plan makes no unsupported claim that they are resolved. The service forecast is explicitly a prediction, not a simulator measurement. No cited evidence makes the planned action unsafe or impossible.
